import sys
import math

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x, y, limit = map(int, data[:3])
    B = x / y
    min_diff = 1e9
    best_num = 0
    best_den = 1
    for i in range(1, limit + 1):
        b = x * i // y
        # candidates: b, abs(b-1), b+1
        candidates = [b, abs(b - 1), b + 1]
        for a in candidates:
            diff = abs(a / i - B)
            if diff < min_diff:
                min_diff = diff
                best_num = a
                best_den = i
    # special case: check if 1/1 is at least as close as the best found fraction
    if abs(1.0 - B) <= abs(best_num / best_den - B) + 1e-9:
        best_num = 1
        best_den = 1
    g = math.gcd(best_num, best_den)
    print(f"{best_num // g}/{best_den // g}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
